description: The four-colour WBVR system of the Sternberg Astronomical Institute, observed with a four-channel photometer at the Tien Shan station.
facility_description: The General Catalogue of Photometric Data (GCPD, Mermilliod, Hauck & Mermilliod; now hosted at Masaryk University, Brno) compiles stellar photometry in more than 80 photometric systems together with system descriptions and filter transmission curves.
notes: NJM's curves for this instrument were taken from the SVO Filter Profile Service (GCPD group). Band Description values are copied verbatim from SVO VOTables, cited via Wayback Machine captures because svo2.cab.inta-csic.es timed out all session; the SVO acknowledgement already on NJM was not re-verified. Bands without the _ADPS suffix whose SVO ProfileReference is arXiv:1412.1474 are the Mann & von Braun (2015) revisions of the GCPD curves; _ADPS bands are the Asiago Database on Photometric Systems versions (Moro & Munari 2000; Fiorucci & Munari 2003), for which SVO's ProfileReference is the GCPD system page. Licence: GCPD publishes no explicit redistribution licence, only a citation request; classed 'attribution' on that basis. GCPD's basic reference is Kornilov et al. 1991, Tr. Gos. Astron. Inst. Shternberga 63; the bibcode guess 1991TrSht..63....1K failed check_refs. GCPD's curve page gives the curve source as 'REF.' (unfilled). No archived SVO VOTable was available for: W, so those bands carry no per-band fields.
